args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money per FIN-212

round_money used ROUND_HALF_UP, but FIN-212 requires banker's rounding
(ROUND_HALF_EVEN). This caused tests/test_money.py to fail in the nightly build.

args.head: fix/banker-rounding-fin-212
args.title: Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but FIN-212 specifies banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This made `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` fail in the nightly build.

## Change
- `src/money.py`: switch the rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`. No other changes.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on `08d3cd5986`: passed.
- Expected results: `2.675 -> 2.68` and `2.665 -> 2.66`, per the test.

## Release
Requested to ship in today's release. Merging into main requires code-owner approval.

- **Cause:** `round_money` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but FIN-212 requires `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.
- **Change:** I created `fix/banker-rounding-fin-212` and switched that one line to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`. Nothing else changed.
- **CI:** Run `ci-0001` passed on commit `08d3cd5986`.
